correctness.rationale: The genus-three smoothness hypotheses and Cartier coefficient formula are checked explicitly. In characteristic three the matrix diagonalizes over F3 with eigenvalues a+b+1, ab+2, a+b-1; Frobenius twists preserve its constant eigenbasis, so stable rank equals number of nonzero eigenvalues. Pairwise simultaneous vanishing forces excluded a=b; each zero locus is A1 minus F3, giving the counts uniformly in q. Bundled independent polynomial and GF(3^m) computations reproduce ranks/counts for m=1,2,3; the infinite theorem rests on algebraic reasoning.
